ko.title: 휴대전화가 먼저 꺼졌다: 파키스탄이 불법화한 카슈미르 항의 운동의 내막

segments.src: **A dispute over twelve legislative seats in Pakistan-administered Kashmir has become something larger: a stress test of how a state responds to a protest movement it cannot easily categorize.
segments.tr: **파키스탄 관리하의 카슈미르 지역에서 12개의 입법 의석을 둘러싼 분쟁이 더 큰 사건으로 번졌습니다. 이는 국가가 쉽게 분류할 수 없는 항의 운동에 어떻게 대응하는지를 보여주는 스트레스 테스트가 되었습니다.**

segments.src: The connectivity blackout that accompanied the crackdown is also the reason nobody can say with confidence how many people have died.**
segments.tr: **단속과 함께 이루어진 통신 차단으로 인해, 얼마나 많은 사람이 사망했는지 누구도 확신 있게 말할 수 없는 상황입니다.**

segments.src: ## The order of events matters
segments.tr: ## 사건의 순서가 중요하다

segments.src: Most accounts of unrest begin with the unrest.
segments.tr: 불안 사태에 대한 대부분의 기록은 불안 사태 자체에서 시작됩니다.

segments.src: This one begins with a signal drop.
segments.tr: 하지만 이 이야기는 신호 끊김에서 시작됩니다.

segments.src: On **June 5, 2026**, the government of Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) declared the Jammu Kashmir Joint Awami Action Committee — the JAAC, the loose coalition that had organized the region's protest politics for three years — a proscribed organization under the **AJK Anti-Terrorism Act, 2014**.
segments.tr: **2026년 6월 5일**, 아자드 잠무 카슈미르(AJK) 정부는 지난 3년간 지역의 항의 정치를 조직해 온 느슨한 연합체인 잠무 카슈미르 공동 시민 행동 위원회(JAAC)를 **AJK 테러 방지법(2014년)**에 따라 금지 단체로 선포했습니다.

segments.src: Internet access across the territory was curtailed the same day.
segments.tr: 같은 날 해당 지역 전역의 인터넷 접속이 제한되었습니다.

segments.src: The monitoring group NetBlocks confirmed a major disruption to connectivity, noting that the shutdown arrived *ahead* of the protests rather than in response to them, and was likely to limit coverage of what followed.
segments.tr: 모니터링 그룹 넷블록스(NetBlocks)는 심각한 연결 장애를 확인하며, 이번 셧다운이 항의 시위로 인한 대응이 아니라 시위 *전*에 이루어졌으며, 이후의 상황에 대한 보도를 제한하려는 의도가 있었을 가능성이 높다고 지적했습니다.

segments.src: Two days later, on **June 7**, the AJK Supreme Court ruled that the twelve reserved assembly seats at the center of the dispute are constitutionally protected and cannot be abolished without a constitutional amendment — closing, at least judicially, the door the protesters had been pushing on.
segments.tr: 이틀 후인 **6월 7일**, AJK 대법원은 분쟁의 중심이 된 12개의 예약 의석이 헌법적으로 보호되며 헌법 개정 없이는 폐지될 수 없다고 판결했습니다. 이로써 시위대가 밀어붙이던 문이 적어도 사법적으로는 닫히게 되었습니다.

segments.src: The mobilization that had been building since talks collapsed in late May became a regionwide movement almost immediately.
segments.tr: 5월 말 협상이 결렬된 이후 쌓여온 동원력은 거의 즉시 지역 전체의 운동으로 확산되었습니다.

segments.src: On **June 8**, initial clashes reportedly killed eleven people.
segments.tr: **6월 8일**, 초기 충돌로 11명이 사망한 것으로 보고되었습니다.

segments.src: On **June 9**, the JAAC called a general strike that shuttered markets, schools, and transport, concentrated most heavily in the **Poonch division**.
segments.tr: **6월 9일**, JAAC는 총파업을 호출하여 시장, 학교, 교통수단을 폐쇄했으며, 특히 **푼치(Poonch) 구역**에 집중되었습니다.

segments.src: By mid-June the reported toll had passed twenty.
segments.tr: 6월 중순까지 보고된 사망자 수는 20명을 넘어섰습니다.

segments.src: The sequence — ban, blackout, court ruling, confrontation — is the story.
segments.tr: 금지, 차단, 법원 판결, 대립이라는 이 순서가 바로 이 이야기의 핵심입니다.

segments.src: It is also why the story is so hard to verify.
segments.tr: 또한 이것이 이 이야기를 검증하기 어렵게 만드는 이유이기도 합니다.

segments.src: ## What the twelve seats actually are
segments.tr: ## 12개 의석의 실체

segments.src: The AJK Legislative Assembly reserves twelve of its seats for **Kashmiri refugees who left Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir after the 1947 partition**, along with their descendants.
segments.tr: AJK 입법 의회는 **1947년 분할 이후 인도 관리하의 잠무 카슈미르를 떠난 카슈미르 난민**과 그 후손들을 위해 12개의 의석을 예약해 두고 있습니다.

segments.src: Those voters live elsewhere in Pakistan — Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa — not in AJK.
segments.tr: 이 유권자들은 AJK가 아닌 펀자브, 신드, 카이베르 파크툰크와 등 파키스탄의 다른 지역에 거주합니다.

segments.src: To supporters of the arrangement, the seats are a constitutional and symbolic commitment: they keep the displaced population represented in the only Kashmiri assembly available to them, and they encode Pakistan's long-standing position that the Kashmir question is unresolved rather than settled by a border.
segments.tr: 이 제도를 지지하는 이들에게 이 의석은 헌법적이고 상징적인 약속입니다. 즉, 이들이 이용할 수 있는 유일한 카슈미르 의회에서 실향민들의 대표성을 유지하고, 카슈미르 문제가 국경으로 해결된 것이 아니라 여전히 미결 상태라는 파키스탄의 오랜 입장을 명문화한 것입니다.

segments.src: To the JAAC and its supporters, the seats are a governance problem with a very practical edge.
segments.tr: 반면 JAAC와 그 지지자들에게 이 의석은 매우 실질적인 거버넌스 문제입니다.

segments.src: Twelve seats in a 53-member house is not a rounding error.
segments.tr: 53석의 의회에서 12석은 단순한 오차 범위가 아닙니다.

segments.src: Because the electorate for those seats sits outside AJK, the argument goes, national parties headquartered in Islamabad and Lahore can assemble a bloc that does not answer to anyone who actually lives with AJK's electricity tariffs, wheat prices, road conditions, or hospital waiting rooms.
segments.tr: 이 의석의 유권자들이 AJK 외부에 거주하기 때문에, 이슬라마바드와 라호르에 본부를 둔 전국 정당들이 AJK의 전기 요금, 밀 가격, 도로 상태, 병원 대기실의 현실을 실제로 겪고 있는 사람들에게는 책임지지 않는 블록을 형성할 수 있다는 주장입니다.

segments.src: The movement's complaint is not primarily about identity.
segments.tr: 이 운동의 불만은 주로 정체성에 관한 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is about who holds the swing vote in a legislature that decides where money goes.
segments.tr: 그것은 예산 집행처를 결정하는 입법부에서 누가 캐스팅보트를 쥐고 있느냐에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: That distinction is what has made the movement difficult for the state to define.
segments.tr: 이러한 차이점이 국가가 이 운동을 정의하기 어렵게 만들었습니다.

segments.src: It is not separatist in the conventional sense, it is not aligned with a militant network, and its demands are budgetary and procedural rather than territorial.
segments.tr: 이 운동은 전통적인 의미의 분리주의가 아니며, 무장 네트워크와 연계되지 않았고, 요구 사항 또한 영토가 아닌 예산과 절차에 관한 것이기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## Thirty-eight points, not one
segments.tr: ## 하나가 아닌 38가지 요구 사항

segments.src: The seats have dominated coverage, but they are a single line in a **38-point charter of demands** the JAAC unveiled in September–October 2025 — itself an escalation of protest cycles running back to 2023 over electricity tariffs, flour subsidies, and everyday governance failures.
segments.tr: 의석 문제가 보도에 지배적이었지만, 이는 JAAC가 2025년 9월~10월에 발표한 **38개 항목의 요구 헌장** 중 단 한 줄에 불과합니다. 이 헌장 자체도 2023년부터 이어진 전기 요금, 밀 보조금, 일상적인 거버넌스 실패에 대한 항의 주기의 심화 과정이었습니다.

segments.src: The charter is unglamorous by design.
segments.tr: 이 헌장은 의도적으로 화려하지 않습니다.

segments.src: It asks for subsidized power and wheat, investigations into alleged corruption, better schools and hospitals, road and infrastructure spending, and reductions in official privileges and perks.
segments.tr: 전기와 밀에 대한 보조금, 부패 혐의 조사, 더 나은 학교와 병원, 도로 및 인프라 지출, 공직자의 특권 및 혜택 축소를 요구합니다.

segments.src: It reads less like a manifesto than like a municipal audit.
segments.tr: 이는 선언문이라기보다 시청 감사 보고서에 가깝습니다.

segments.src: Officials say most of it has already been delivered.
segments.tr: 정부 관계자들은 대부분의 요구 사항이 이미 이행되었다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Leaders in the governing Pakistan Peoples Party bloc have said **35 of the 38 demands** have been implemented, with the remainder blocked by cost, feasibility, or — in the case of the reserved seats — the courts.
segments.tr: 집권 파키스탄 인민당(PPP) 블록의 지도자들은 **38개 요구 사항 중 35개**가 이행되었으며, 나머지는 비용, 타당성, 또는 예약 의석의 경우 법원에 의해 가로막혔다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: The JAAC disputes both the count and the quality of implementation.
segments.tr: JAAC는 이행 건수와 질 모두에 이의를 제기합니다.

segments.src: With independent verification constrained by the communications restrictions, that disagreement has no easy referee.
segments.tr: 통신 제한으로 인해 독립적인 검증이 제약된 상황에서, 이러한 의견 차이를 중재할 쉬운 방법은 없습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the death toll is a range, not a number
segments.tr: ## 사망자 수가 숫자가 아닌 범위로 나타나는 이유

segments.src: This is the part of the story that resists a clean sentence.
segments.tr: 이 부분은 명확한 문장으로 정리하기 어려운 이야기입니다.

segments.src: - **Amnesty International**, on July 28, said at least **40 people** had been killed — 34 protesters and six police and paramilitary personnel.
segments.tr: - **앰네스티 인터내셔널**은 7월 28일, 최소 **40명**이 사망했으며, 이 중 34명은 시위대, 6명은 경찰 및 준군사 조직원이라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: - **Local residents and activists** have put the civilian figure higher, in the range of 50 to 60 or more.
segments.tr: - **지역 주민과 활동가들**은 민간인 사망자 수를 50~60명 또는 그 이상으로 더 높게 잡고 있습니다.

segments.src: - The **JAAC's own documentation** claims roughly 80 deaths.
segments.tr: - **JAAC 자체 기록**은 약 80명의 사망자를 주장합니다.

segments.src: - **Independent journalist Harris Qadeer** reported 89 deaths across Rawalakot and Mirpur by late July.
segments.tr: - **독립 언론인 해리스 카디르(Harris Qadeer)**는 7월 말까지 라왈라코트와 미르푸르 전역에서 89명이 사망했다고 보도했습니다.

segments.src: - The AJK and federal governments have **not published an official toll**.
segments.tr: - AJK 및 연방 정부는 **공식 사망자 수를 발표하지 않았습니다**.

segments.src: Those numbers are not simply competing estimates from equally equipped counters.
segments.tr: 이 숫자들은 단순히 동일한 능력을 갖춘 집계자들의 서로 다른 추정치가 아닙니다.

segments.src: They are what happens when mobile networks and internet access in the affected districts are restricted for weeks, roadblocks limit movement, and reporters cannot reach the areas where the worst incidents are alleged to have occurred.
segments.tr: 이는 해당 구역의 모바일 네트워크와 인터넷 접속이 몇 주 동안 제한되고, 도로 봉쇄로 이동이 제한되며, 기자들이 최악의 사건이 발생했다고 주장되는 지역에 접근할 수 없을 때 발생하는 현상입니다.

segments.src: NetBlocks documented severe restrictions from early June; connectivity monitors recorded limited service persisting into August.
segments.tr: 넷블록스는 6월 초부터 심각한 제한을 기록했으며, 연결성 모니터링 결과 8월까지 제한적인 서비스가 지속되었습니다.

segments.src: A blackout does not just suppress information.
segments.tr: 블랙아웃은 단순히 정보를 억제하는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It degrades it.
segments.tr: 그것은 정보를 훼손합니다.

segments.src: In the absence of verifiable reporting, both inflated and deflated claims circulate freely, and the resulting fog becomes its own argument — for the state, evidence that the movement traffics in exaggeration; for the movement, evidence that the state is hiding something.
segments.tr: 검증 가능한 보도가 없는 상황에서, 부풀려진 주장과 축소된 주장이 자유롭게 유포되며, 그 결과로 생긴 안개는 그 자체로 논거가 됩니다. 국가에게는 이 운동이 과장을 일삼는다는 증거가 되고, 운동 측에는 국가가 무언가를 숨기고 있다는 증거가 됩니다.

segments.src: Neither side can be checked, which is precisely the problem.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽도 확인할 수 없다는 것이 바로 문제입니다.

segments.src: ## What proscription does
segments.tr: ## 금지 조치의 효과

segments.src: Designation under the Anti-Terrorism Act is not a symbolic label.
segments.tr: 테러 방지법에 따른 지정은 단순한 상징적 라벨이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It converts organizing into a prosecutable offense, exposes bank accounts and property to freezing, and criminalizes participation, fundraising, and public advocacy.
segments.tr: 이는 조직 활동을 기소 가능한 범죄로 전환시키고, 은행 계좌와 재산을 동결하며, 참여, 자금 조달 및 공개 옹호를 범죄화합니다.

segments.src: Four JAAC spokespeople — **Shaukat Nawaz Mir, Sardar Umar Nazir, Khawaja Mehran Arshad, and Sardar Aman Khan** — were placed on wanted lists, with bounties reported at roughly $36,000 for information leading to arrests.
segments.tr: JAAC 대변인 4명 — **쇼카트 나와즈 미르(Shaukat Nawaz Mir), 사르다르 우마르 나지르(Sardar Umar Nazir), 카와자 메흐란 아르샤드(Khawaja Mehran Arshad), 사르다르 아만 칸(Sardar Aman Khan)** — 이 수배 명단에 올랐으며, 체포로 이어지는 정보 제공에 대해 약 36,000달러의 현상금이 걸린 것으로 보고되었습니다.

segments.src: Mir was arrested on June 30.
segments.tr: 미르는 6월 30일에 체포되었습니다.

segments.src: Other organizers, including Syed Farhad Ali Shah in mid-June, were reported detained.
segments.tr: 6월 중순의 사이이드 파르하드 알리 샤(Syed Farhad Ali Shah)를 포함한 다른 조직가들도 구금된 것으로 보고되었습니다.

segments.src: On August 1, journalists **Razi Tahir and Muhammad Saif** were reported taken into custody in Islamabad.
segments.tr: 8월 1일, 기자 **라지 타히르(Razi Tahir)와 무함마드 사이프(Muhammad Saif)**가 이슬라마바드에서 구금된 것으로 보고되었습니다.

segments.src: **Amnesty International** called the terrorism designation of a protest movement "a dangerous escalation," and **UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk** joined calls for restraint and investigation into the use of force.
segments.tr: **앰네스티 인터내셔널**은 항의 운동을 테러 단체로 지정한 것을 "위험한 에스컬레이션"이라고 불렀으며, **유엔 인권최고대표 볼커 튀르크(Volker Türk)**는 자제와 무력 사용에 대한 조사를 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: India's foreign ministry also issued criticism — which Pakistan rejected as interference, with military spokesperson **Lieutenant-General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry** saying authorities had exercised "wisdom and restraint" and that the deployment of force remains solely a state prerogative.
segments.tr: 인도 외무성 또한 비판을 제기했으나, 파키스탄은 이를 간섭으로 일축했습니다. 군 대변인 **아메드 샤리프 초드리(Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry) 중장**은 당국이 "지혜와 자제력"을 발휘했으며, 무력 배치는 전적으로 국가의 특권이라고 말했습니다.

segments.src: The government's tone has not been uniform.
segments.tr: 정부의 톤은 일관되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: AJK Prime Minister **Faisal Mumtaz Rathore** publicly offered dialogue.
segments.tr: AJK 총리 **파이살 뭄타즈 라토르(Faisal Mumtaz Rathore)**는 공개적으로 대화를 제안했습니다.

segments.src: Federal Defence Minister **Khawaja Asif** took a markedly harder line, framing the protesters' obligation as obedience to the state.
segments.tr: 반면 연방 국방부 장관 **카와자 아시프(Khawaja Asif)**는 시위대의 의무가 국가에 대한 복종이라고 규정하며 현저히 강경한 입장을 취했습니다.

segments.src: Both positions are official; they point in opposite directions.
segments.tr: 두 입장 모두 공식적이지만, 서로 정반대 방향을 가리키고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## An election held in the dark
segments.tr: ## 어둠 속에서 치러진 선거

segments.src: The crackdown collided with a scheduled local election, conducted in three phases:
segments.tr: 단속은 세 단계로 진행된 예정된 지방 선거와 충돌했습니다.

segments.src: | Phase | Date | Area |
segments.tr: | 단계 | 날짜 | 지역 |

segments.src: | First | July 27 | Mirpur division |
segments.tr: | 1단계 | 7월 27일 | 미르푸르 구역 |

segments.src: | Second | August 2 | Muzaffarabad division |
segments.tr: | 2단계 | 8월 2일 | 무자파라바드 구역 |

segments.src: | Third | August 10 (scheduled) | Poonch division |
segments.tr: | 3단계 | 8월 10일 (예정) | 푼치 구역 |

segments.src: The first phase coincided with a JAAC march and further deadly confrontations.
segments.tr: 1단계는 JAAC 행진과 추가적인 치명적 충돌이 겹쳤습니다.

segments.src: Among those killed was **Sardar Usman Nazir**, brother of JAAC leader Sardar Umar Nazir.
segments.tr: 사망자 중에는 JAAC 지도자 사르다르 우마르 나지르의 형제인 **사르다르 우스만 나지르(Sardar Usman Nazir)**가 포함되어 있었습니다.

segments.src: Nazir has denied that the movement is responsible for violence, alleging that incidents were staged — a claim the government rejects and which, like most claims in this dispute, cannot currently be independently assessed.
segments.tr: 나지르는 이 운동이 폭력에 책임이 있다는 것을 부인하며, 사건들이 조작되었다고 주장했습니다. 정부는 이 주장을 거부하며, 이 분쟁의 대부분의 주장처럼 현재로서는 독립적으로 평가할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: The JAAC called for a boycott.
segments.tr: JAAC는 보이콧을 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: Authorities reported turnout above 50 percent and results favoring parties aligned with the federal ruling coalition in the early phases.
segments.tr: 당국은 초기 단계에서 투표율이 50%를 넘었고, 결과가 연방 집권 연합과 연계된 정당들에 유리하게 나왔다고 보고했습니다.

segments.src: The third phase is scheduled for **Poonch** — the division where the protests have been most intense and where verification has been hardest.
segments.tr: 3단계는 시위가 가장 격렬했고 검증이 가장 어려웠던 **푼치** 구역에서 치러질 예정입니다.

segments.src: Whether a turnout figure means much under those conditions is a genuinely open question, and one that will be argued regardless of the final count.
segments.tr: 그러한 조건 하에서 투표율 수치가 큰 의미가 있는지 여부는 진정으로 열린 질문이며, 최종 집계와 상관없이 논쟁이 될 것입니다.

segments.src: ## The actual test
segments.tr: ## 실제 테스트

segments.src: Strip away the specifics and what remains is a problem states face more often than they admit: a movement with local, material, largely legalistic demands, no armed wing, and enough popular reach to shut down commerce across a territory.
segments.tr: 구체적인 내용을 걷어내면 남는 것은 국가가 인정하는 것보다 더 자주 직면하는 문제입니다. 즉, 지역적이고 물질적인, 대체로 법률적인 요구 사항을 가지고 있으며, 무장 조직이 없고, 지역 전역의 상업 활동을 중단시킬 만큼의 대중적 영향력을 가진 운동입니다.

segments.src: Such a movement can be **negotiated with**, which concedes that grievances are legitimate and invites more of them.
segments.tr: 이런 운동은 **협상할 수** 있으며, 이는 불만이 정당하다는 것을 인정하고 더 많은 불만을 불러일으킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: It can be **ignored**, which usually escalates.
segments.tr: 또는 **무시할 수** 있으며, 이는 보통 상황을 악화시킵니다.

segments.src: Or it can be **reclassified** — moved from the category of politics into the category of security, where a far wider set of tools becomes available and the question of whether the demands were reasonable stops being the operative one.
segments.tr: 아니면 **재분류할 수** 있습니다. 즉, 정치의 범주에서 안보의 범주로 옮겨, 훨씬 더 넓은 도구 세트를 사용할 수 있게 하고, 요구 사항이 합리적이었는지에 대한 질문을 더 이상 유효하게 만들지 않는 것입니다.

segments.src: The June 5 proscription was that reclassification.
segments.tr: 6월 5일의 금지 조치는 바로 그 재분류였습니다.

segments.src: It arrived *before* the mass mobilization, not after, and alongside a blackout that made the consequences difficult to document.
segments.tr: 그것은 대규모 동원 *이후*가 아니라 *전*에 이루어졌으며, 결과를 기록하기 어렵게 만드는 블랙아웃과 함께 진행되었습니다.

segments.src: That ordering is what critics point to, and it is the substance of the objection: not that the state acted, but that it defined the problem in a way that removed the need to answer it.
segments.tr: 비판론자들이 지적하는 것이 바로 이 순서이며, 이것이 반대의 핵심입니다. 국가가 행동했다는 것이 아니라, 국가가 문제를 정의하는 방식으로 답할 필요성을 제거했다는 것입니다.

segments.src: Whether that judgment holds up will depend on evidence that does not yet exist in verifiable form — accurate casualty records, an accounting of detentions, and reporting from Poonch.
segments.tr: 그 판단이 유지될지는 아직 검증 가능한 형태로 존재하지 않는 증거들 — 정확한 사상자 기록, 구금자 명단, 푼치 지역의 보도 — 에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: Restoring connectivity is the precondition for producing any of it.
segments.tr: 통신을 복구하는 것이 이 모든 것을 생산하기 위한 전제 조건입니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 향후 주목할 점

segments.src: - **The August 10 Poonch phase** — the decisive test of whether the electoral process holds in the movement's stronghold.
segments.tr: - **8월 10일 푼치 단계** — 운동의 거점에서 선거 프로세스가 유지되는지에 대한 결정적인 테스트가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Connectivity restoration** — the single best indicator of whether authorities expect further confrontation, and the gate on all independent verification.
segments.tr: - **통신 복구** — 당국이 추가 충돌을 예상하는지 여부를 보여주는 가장 좋은 지표이자, 모든 독립적 검증의 관문입니다.

segments.src: - **The status of the proscription** — whether the ATA designation is maintained, narrowed, or challenged in court after the election cycle closes.
segments.tr: - **금지 조치 상태** — 선거 주기가 끝난 후 ATA 지정이 유지되는지, 축소되는지, 또는 법원에서 다투어지는지에 대한 여부입니다.

segments.src: - **An official casualty accounting** — its release, or continued absence, will shape international pressure more than any statement.
segments.tr: - **공식 사상자 집계** — 이것의 발표 여부나 지속적인 부재는 그 어떤 성명보다 국제적 압력에 더 큰 영향을 미칠 것입니다.

segments.src: - **The reserved seats question** — with the judicial route closed, the only remaining path is a constitutional amendment, which returns the issue to the legislature the protesters say is the problem.
segments.tr: - **예약 의석 문제** — 사법적 경로가 막힌 상황에서 남은 유일한 길은 헌법 개정이며, 이는 시위대가 문제라고 말하는 입법부로 이 문제를 다시 돌려보내는 것입니다.

segments.src: ### Editor's note on sourcing
segments.tr: ### 출처에 관한 편집자 주

segments.src: Figures in this article are contested and attributed to their sources rather than presented as established fact.
segments.tr: 이 기사의 수치들은 논쟁의 여지가 있으며, 확립된 사실로 제시하기보다 출처별로 귀속시켰습니다.

segments.src: Communications restrictions in the affected districts have prevented independent verification of casualty counts, detention numbers, and specific incidents; reported totals from official bodies, rights organizations, journalists, and the movement itself differ substantially.
segments.tr: 해당 구역의 통신 제한으로 인해 사상자 수, 구금자 수 및 특정 사건에 대한 독립적인 검증이 불가능했습니다. 공식 기관, 인권 단체, 언론인 및 운동 측에서 보고한 총계는 상당히 다릅니다.

segments.src: This piece summarizes publicly reported information as of early August 2026 and takes no position on the underlying political dispute.
segments.tr: 이 글은 2026년 8월 초까지 공개적으로 보고된 정보를 요약한 것이며, 근본적인 정치적 분쟁에 대해 어떤 입장도 취하지 않습니다.

segments.tr: 접근성이 개선됨에 따라 세부 사항이 변경될 수 있습니다.

zh.title: 手机先黑屏：揭秘被巴基斯坦宣布为非法的克什米尔抗议运动

segments.src: **A dispute over twelve legislative seats in Pakistan-administered Kashmir has become something larger: a stress test of how a state responds to a protest movement it cannot easily categorize.
segments.tr: **巴基斯坦管理的克什米尔地区关于十二个立法席位的争议已演变成更严重的问题：这是一次关于国家如何应对无法轻易定性的抗议运动的压力测试。**

segments.src: The connectivity blackout that accompanied the crackdown is also the reason nobody can say with confidence how many people have died.**
segments.tr: **伴随镇压而来的通信中断，也是没有人能确信有多少人死亡的原因。**

segments.src: ## The order of events matters
segments.tr: ## 事件顺序至关重要

segments.src: Most accounts of unrest begin with the unrest.
segments.tr: 大多数关于动荡的报道都始于动荡本身。

segments.src: This one begins with a signal drop.
segments.tr: 而这一次，始于信号中断。

segments.src: On **June 5, 2026**, the government of Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) declared the Jammu Kashmir Joint Awami Action Committee — the JAAC, the loose coalition that had organized the region's protest politics for three years — a proscribed organization under the **AJK Anti-Terrorism Act, 2014**.
segments.tr: 在 **2026年6月5日**，自由查谟和克什米尔（AJK）政府宣布查谟克什米尔联合民众行动委员会（JAAC）——这个组织了该地区三年抗议政治的松散联盟——根据 **《AJK 2014年反恐法》** 为禁制组织。

segments.src: Internet access across the territory was curtailed the same day.
segments.tr: 同一天，该地区的互联网访问被限制。

segments.src: The monitoring group NetBlocks confirmed a major disruption to connectivity, noting that the shutdown arrived *ahead* of the protests rather than in response to them, and was likely to limit coverage of what followed.
segments.tr: 监测组织 NetBlocks 确认了严重的连接中断，并指出此次关停发生在抗议 *之前* 而非是对抗议的响应，这可能会限制对后续事件的报道。

segments.src: Two days later, on **June 7**, the AJK Supreme Court ruled that the twelve reserved assembly seats at the center of the dispute are constitutionally protected and cannot be abolished without a constitutional amendment — closing, at least judicially, the door the protesters had been pushing on.
segments.tr: 两天后，在 **6月7日**，AJK 最高法院裁定，争议中心的十二个保留议席在宪法上受到保护，未经宪法修正不能废除——这在司法层面至少关闭了抗议者一直试图推开的大门。

segments.src: The mobilization that had been building since talks collapsed in late May became a regionwide movement almost immediately.
segments.tr: 自5月下旬谈判破裂以来一直在积聚的动员，几乎立即演变成了一场全地区性的运动。

segments.src: On **June 8**, initial clashes reportedly killed eleven people.
segments.tr: 据报道，**6月8日** 的初步冲突导致11人死亡。

segments.src: On **June 9**, the JAAC called a general strike that shuttered markets, schools, and transport, concentrated most heavily in the **Poonch division**.
segments.tr: 在 **6月9日**，JAAC 发起总罢工，导致市场、学校和交通瘫痪，其中在 **蓬奇分局（Poonch division）** 最为严重。

segments.src: By mid-June the reported toll had passed twenty.
segments.tr: 到6月中旬，报道的死亡人数已超过20人。

segments.src: The sequence — ban, blackout, court ruling, confrontation — is the story.
segments.tr: 这一顺序——禁令、黑屏、法院裁决、对抗——就是故事的核心。

segments.src: It is also why the story is so hard to verify.
segments.tr: 这也是为什么这个故事如此难以核实。

segments.src: ## What the twelve seats actually are
segments.tr: ## 这十二个席位究竟是什么

segments.src: The AJK Legislative Assembly reserves twelve of its seats for **Kashmiri refugees who left Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir after the 1947 partition**, along with their descendants.
segments.tr: AJK 立法议会为 **1947年分治后离开印度管理之查谟和克什米尔的克什米尔难民** 及其后代保留了十二个席位。

segments.src: Those voters live elsewhere in Pakistan — Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa — not in AJK.
segments.tr: 这些选民居住在巴基斯坦的其他地方——旁遮普省、信德省、开伯尔-普什图省——而非 AJK。

segments.src: To supporters of the arrangement, the seats are a constitutional and symbolic commitment: they keep the displaced population represented in the only Kashmiri assembly available to them, and they encode Pakistan's long-standing position that the Kashmir question is unresolved rather than settled by a border.
segments.tr: 对于该安排的支持者来说，这些席位是宪法和象征性的承诺：它们确保了流离失所的人群在唯一可用的克什米尔议会中拥有代表权，并体现了巴基斯坦长期以来的立场，即克什米尔问题尚未解决，而非由边界决定。

segments.src: To the JAAC and its supporters, the seats are a governance problem with a very practical edge.
segments.tr: 对于 JAAC 及其支持者来说，这些席位是一个具有非常实际影响的治理问题。

segments.src: Twelve seats in a 53-member house is not a rounding error.
segments.tr: 在53个成员的议会中，十二个席位并非微不足道的误差。

segments.src: Because the electorate for those seats sits outside AJK, the argument goes, national parties headquartered in Islamabad and Lahore can assemble a bloc that does not answer to anyone who actually lives with AJK's electricity tariffs, wheat prices, road conditions, or hospital waiting rooms.
segments.tr: 论点是，由于这些席位的选民位于 AJK 之外，总部位于伊斯兰堡和拉合尔的国家政党可以组建一个不向任何实际生活在 AJK、承受电费、小麦价格、道路状况或医院候诊室之苦的人负责的集团。

segments.src: The movement's complaint is not primarily about identity.
segments.tr: 该运动的诉求主要并非关于身份认同。

segments.src: It is about who holds the swing vote in a legislature that decides where money goes.
segments.tr: 而是关于在决定资金去向的立法机构中，谁掌握着关键的摇摆票。

segments.src: That distinction is what has made the movement difficult for the state to define.
segments.tr: 正是这种区别使得国家难以定义该运动。

segments.src: It is not separatist in the conventional sense, it is not aligned with a militant network, and its demands are budgetary and procedural rather than territorial.
segments.tr: 它在传统意义上不是分裂主义，没有与武装网络结盟，其要求是预算和程序性的，而非领土性的。

segments.src: ## Thirty-eight points, not one
segments.tr: ## 三十八项要求，而非一项

segments.src: The seats have dominated coverage, but they are a single line in a **38-point charter of demands** the JAAC unveiled in September–October 2025 — itself an escalation of protest cycles running back to 2023 over electricity tariffs, flour subsidies, and everyday governance failures.
segments.tr: 席位问题主导了报道，但它们只是 JAAC 在 2025年9月至10月公布的 **38项要求宪章** 中的一项——这本身就是自 2023年以来针对电费、面粉补贴和日常治理失败而进行的抗议循环的升级。

segments.src: The charter is unglamorous by design.
segments.tr: 该宪章在设计上就毫无光彩。

segments.src: It asks for subsidized power and wheat, investigations into alleged corruption, better schools and hospitals, road and infrastructure spending, and reductions in official privileges and perks.
segments.tr: 它要求补贴电力和小麦、调查涉嫌腐败的行为、改善学校和医院、增加道路和基础设施支出，以及减少官员的特权和津贴。

segments.src: It reads less like a manifesto than like a municipal audit.
segments.tr: 它读起来不像一份宣言，而像是一次市政审计。

segments.src: Officials say most of it has already been delivered.
segments.tr: 官员们表示，其中大部分已经实现。

segments.src: Leaders in the governing Pakistan Peoples Party bloc have said **35 of the 38 demands** have been implemented, with the remainder blocked by cost, feasibility, or — in the case of the reserved seats — the courts.
segments.tr: 执政的巴基斯坦人民党集团领导人表示，**38项要求中的35项** 已经实施，其余部分因成本、可行性或（在保留席位的情况下）法院的限制而受阻。

segments.src: The JAAC disputes both the count and the quality of implementation.
segments.tr: JAAC 对实施的数量和质量均持有异议。

segments.src: With independent verification constrained by the communications restrictions, that disagreement has no easy referee.
segments.tr: 由于通信限制导致独立核实受限，这种分歧没有简单的裁判。

segments.src: ## Why the death toll is a range, not a number
segments.tr: ## 为什么死亡人数是一个范围，而不是一个数字

segments.src: This is the part of the story that resists a clean sentence.
segments.tr: 这是故事中难以用简洁句子概括的部分。

segments.src: - **Amnesty International**, on July 28, said at least **40 people** had been killed — 34 protesters and six police and paramilitary personnel.
segments.tr: - **国际特赦组织** 在 7月28日 表示，至少有 **40人** 死亡——其中 34名抗议者和 6名警察及准军事人员。

segments.src: - **Local residents and activists** have put the civilian figure higher, in the range of 50 to 60 or more.
segments.tr: - **当地居民和活动人士** 认为平民死亡人数更高，在 50 到 60 人或更多。

segments.src: - The **JAAC's own documentation** claims roughly 80 deaths.
segments.tr: - **JAAC 自身的记录** 声称大约有 80人死亡。

segments.src: - **Independent journalist Harris Qadeer** reported 89 deaths across Rawalakot and Mirpur by late July.
segments.tr: - **独立记者 Harris Qadeer** 报道，到 7月下旬，拉瓦拉科特（Rawalakot）和米尔普尔（Mirpur）共有 89人死亡。

segments.src: - The AJK and federal governments have **not published an official toll**.
segments.tr: - AJK 和联邦政府 **尚未公布官方死亡人数**。

segments.src: Those numbers are not simply competing estimates from equally equipped counters.
segments.tr: 这些数字并非简单地来自设备相当的统计者的竞争性估计。

segments.src: They are what happens when mobile networks and internet access in the affected districts are restricted for weeks, roadblocks limit movement, and reporters cannot reach the areas where the worst incidents are alleged to have occurred.
segments.tr: 当受影响地区的移动网络和互联网访问被限制数周，路障限制移动，且记者无法到达据称发生最严重事件的地区时，就会出现这种情况。

segments.src: NetBlocks documented severe restrictions from early June; connectivity monitors recorded limited service persisting into August.
segments.tr: NetBlocks 记录了从 6月初开始的严重限制；连接监测显示有限的服务一直持续到 8月。

segments.src: A blackout does not just suppress information.
segments.tr: 黑屏不仅是压制信息。

segments.src: It degrades it.
segments.tr: 它还降低了信息的质量。

segments.src: In the absence of verifiable reporting, both inflated and deflated claims circulate freely, and the resulting fog becomes its own argument — for the state, evidence that the movement traffics in exaggeration; for the movement, evidence that the state is hiding something.
segments.tr: 在缺乏可核实报道的情况下，夸大和缩小的说法都能自由传播，由此产生的迷雾本身变成了论据——对于国家来说，这是运动在夸大的证据；对于运动来说，这是国家在隐瞒某些事情的证据。

segments.src: Neither side can be checked, which is precisely the problem.
segments.tr: 双方都无法被核实，而这正是问题所在。

segments.src: ## What proscription does
segments.tr: ## 禁制令的作用

segments.src: Designation under the Anti-Terrorism Act is not a symbolic label.
segments.tr: 根据《反恐法》被定性并非一个象征性的标签。

segments.src: It converts organizing into a prosecutable offense, exposes bank accounts and property to freezing, and criminalizes participation, fundraising, and public advocacy.
segments.tr: 它将组织活动转化为可起诉的罪行，使银行账户和财产面临被冻结的风险，并将参与、筹款和公开倡导定为犯罪。

segments.src: Four JAAC spokespeople — **Shaukat Nawaz Mir, Sardar Umar Nazir, Khawaja Mehran Arshad, and Sardar Aman Khan** — were placed on wanted lists, with bounties reported at roughly $36,000 for information leading to arrests.
segments.tr: 四名 JAAC 发言人——**Shaukat Nawaz Mir, Sardar Umar Nazir, Khawaja Mehran Arshad, 和 Sardar Aman Khan** ——被列入通缉名单，据报道，提供导致逮捕的信息可获得约 36,000 美元的赏金。

segments.src: Mir was arrested on June 30.
segments.tr: Mir 在 6月30日 被捕。

segments.src: Other organizers, including Syed Farhad Ali Shah in mid-June, were reported detained.
segments.tr: 其他组织者，包括 6月中旬的 Syed Farhad Ali Shah，据报道被拘留。

segments.src: On August 1, journalists **Razi Tahir and Muhammad Saif** were reported taken into custody in Islamabad.
segments.tr: 8月1日，记者 **Razi Tahir 和 Muhammad Saif** 据报道在伊斯兰堡被拘捕。

segments.src: **Amnesty International** called the terrorism designation of a protest movement "a dangerous escalation," and **UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk** joined calls for restraint and investigation into the use of force.
segments.tr: **国际特赦组织** 将抗议运动被定性为恐怖主义称为“危险的升级”，**联合国人权事务高级专员 Volker Türk** 也加入了呼吁克制并调查武力使用的呼吁。

segments.src: India's foreign ministry also issued criticism — which Pakistan rejected as interference, with military spokesperson **Lieutenant-General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry** saying authorities had exercised "wisdom and restraint" and that the deployment of force remains solely a state prerogative.
segments.tr: 印度外交部也发表了批评——巴基斯坦将其斥为干涉，军方发言人 **中将 Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry** 表示，当局行使了“智慧和克制”，且部署武力完全是国家的特权。

segments.src: The government's tone has not been uniform.
segments.tr: 政府的语气并不统一。

segments.src: AJK Prime Minister **Faisal Mumtaz Rathore** publicly offered dialogue.
segments.tr: AJK 总理 **Faisal Mumtaz Rathore** 公开提出对话。

segments.src: Federal Defence Minister **Khawaja Asif** took a markedly harder line, framing the protesters' obligation as obedience to the state.
segments.tr: 联邦国防部长 **Khawaja Asif** 则采取了明显更强硬的立场，将抗议者的义务定义为对国家的服从。

segments.src: Both positions are official; they point in opposite directions.
segments.tr: 两种立场都是官方的；但它们指向相反的方向。

segments.src: ## An election held in the dark
segments.tr: ## 在黑暗中举行的选举

segments.src: The crackdown collided with a scheduled local election, conducted in three phases:
segments.tr: 镇压与预定的地方选举相撞，选举分三个阶段进行：

segments.src: | Phase | Date | Area |
segments.tr: | 阶段 | 日期 | 地区 |

segments.src: | First | July 27 | Mirpur division |
segments.tr: | 第一阶段 | 7月27日 | 米尔普尔分局 |

segments.src: | Second | August 2 | Muzaffarabad division |
segments.tr: | 第二阶段 | 8月2日 | 穆扎法拉巴德分局 |

segments.src: | Third | August 10 (scheduled) | Poonch division |
segments.tr: | 第三阶段 | 8月10日（预定） | 蓬奇分局 |

segments.src: The first phase coincided with a JAAC march and further deadly confrontations.
segments.tr: 第一阶段与 JAAC 的游行以及进一步的致命冲突重合。

segments.src: Among those killed was **Sardar Usman Nazir**, brother of JAAC leader Sardar Umar Nazir.
segments.tr: 死者中包括 **Sardar Usman Nazir**，他是 JAAC 领导人 Sardar Umar Nazir 的弟弟。

segments.src: Nazir has denied that the movement is responsible for violence, alleging that incidents were staged — a claim the government rejects and which, like most claims in this dispute, cannot currently be independently assessed.
segments.tr: Nazir 否认该运动应对暴力负责，声称事件是伪造的——政府否认这一说法，且与该争议中的大多数说法一样，目前无法独立评估。

segments.src: The JAAC called for a boycott.
segments.tr: JAAC 呼吁抵制选举。

segments.src: Authorities reported turnout above 50 percent and results favoring parties aligned with the federal ruling coalition in the early phases.
segments.tr: 当局报告称，前几个阶段的投票率在 50% 以上，结果有利于与联邦执政联盟结盟的政党。

segments.src: The third phase is scheduled for **Poonch** — the division where the protests have been most intense and where verification has been hardest.
segments.tr: 第三阶段预定在 **蓬奇（Poonch）** 举行——该分局是抗议最激烈且核实最困难的地区。

segments.src: Whether a turnout figure means much under those conditions is a genuinely open question, and one that will be argued regardless of the final count.
segments.tr: 在这种条件下，投票率数字是否具有意义，是一个真正开放的问题，且无论最终统计结果如何，人们都会对此产生争论。

segments.src: ## The actual test
segments.tr: ## 真正的测试

segments.src: Strip away the specifics and what remains is a problem states face more often than they admit: a movement with local, material, largely legalistic demands, no armed wing, and enough popular reach to shut down commerce across a territory.
segments.tr: 剥离具体细节后，剩下的一个国家经常面临但并不愿承认的问题是：一个拥有局部、物质、在很大程度上是法律诉求的运动，没有武装翼，且拥有足够的民众影响力来瘫痪整个地区的商业。

segments.src: Such a movement can be **negotiated with**, which concedes that grievances are legitimate and invites more of them.
segments.tr: 这样的运动可以 **通过谈判解决**，但这意味着承认诉求是合理的，并会邀请更多此类诉求。

segments.src: It can be **ignored**, which usually escalates.
segments.tr: 它可以被 **忽略**，但这通常会导致升级。

segments.src: Or it can be **reclassified** — moved from the category of politics into the category of security, where a far wider set of tools becomes available and the question of whether the demands were reasonable stops being the operative one.
segments.tr: 或者它可以被 **重新分类** —— 从政治类别移至安全类别，这样可以使用更广泛的工具，而诉求是否合理的问题就不再是核心问题。

segments.src: The June 5 proscription was that reclassification.
segments.tr: 6月5日的禁制令就是这种重新分类。

segments.src: It arrived *before* the mass mobilization, not after, and alongside a blackout that made the consequences difficult to document.
segments.tr: 它发生在群众动员 *之前* 而非之后，并伴随着使后果难以记录的黑屏。

segments.src: That ordering is what critics point to, and it is the substance of the objection: not that the state acted, but that it defined the problem in a way that removed the need to answer it.
segments.tr: 批评者指出正是这一点，这也是反对意见的实质：不是国家采取了行动，而是它以一种消除了回答诉求必要性的方式定义了问题。

segments.src: Whether that judgment holds up will depend on evidence that does not yet exist in verifiable form — accurate casualty records, an accounting of detentions, and reporting from Poonch.
segments.tr: 这种判断是否成立，将取决于尚未以可核实形式存在的证据——准确的伤亡记录、拘留人数的统计以及来自蓬奇的报道。

segments.src: Restoring connectivity is the precondition for producing any of it.
segments.tr: 恢复连接是产生任何此类证据的前提条件。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 接下来的关注点

segments.src: - **The August 10 Poonch phase** — the decisive test of whether the electoral process holds in the movement's stronghold.
segments.tr: - **8月10日的蓬奇阶段** —— 决定选举过程在运动据点是否能维持的决定性测试。

segments.src: - **Connectivity restoration** — the single best indicator of whether authorities expect further confrontation, and the gate on all independent verification.
segments.tr: - **连接恢复** —— 衡量当局是否预期进一步对抗的唯一最佳指标，也是所有独立核实的大门。

segments.src: - **The status of the proscription** — whether the ATA designation is maintained, narrowed, or challenged in court after the election cycle closes.
segments.tr: - **禁制令状态** —— 在选举周期结束后，ATA 定性是否维持、缩小或在法院受到挑战。

segments.src: - **An official casualty accounting** — its release, or continued absence, will shape international pressure more than any statement.
segments.tr: - **官方伤亡统计** —— 其发布或持续缺失，将比任何声明更能影响国际压力。

segments.src: - **The reserved seats question** — with the judicial route closed, the only remaining path is a constitutional amendment, which returns the issue to the legislature the protesters say is the problem.
segments.tr: - **保留席位问题** —— 司法途径已关闭，唯一剩下的路径是宪法修正案，这将使问题回到抗议者认为是有问题的立法机构中。

segments.src: ### Editor's note on sourcing
segments.tr: ### 关于来源的编辑注

segments.src: Figures in this article are contested and attributed to their sources rather than presented as established fact.
segments.tr: 本文中的数字存在争议，并标注了来源，而非将其作为既定事实呈现。

segments.src: Communications restrictions in the affected districts have prevented independent verification of casualty counts, detention numbers, and specific incidents; reported totals from official bodies, rights organizations, journalists, and the movement itself differ substantially.
segments.tr: 受影响地区的通信限制阻碍了对伤亡人数、拘留人数和具体事件的独立核实；来自官方机构、人权组织、记者和运动本身的报告总数存在显著差异。

segments.src: This piece summarizes publicly reported information as of early August 2026 and takes no position on the underlying political dispute.
segments.tr: 本文总结了截至 2026年8月初 的公开报道信息，不对潜在的政治争议采取立场。

segments.src: Details may change as access improves.
segments.tr: 随着访问权限的提高，细节可能会发生变化。

hi.title: फोन पहले अंधेरे में चले गए: पाकिस्तान द्वारा प्रतिबंधित कश्मीर विरोध आंदोलन के अंदर

segments.src: **A dispute over twelve legislative seats in Pakistan-administered Kashmir has become something larger: a stress test of how a state responds to a protest movement it cannot easily categorize.
segments.tr: **पाकिस्तान प्रशासित कश्मीर में बारह विधायी सीटों के विवाद ने कुछ बड़ा रूप ले लिया है: यह एक तनाव परीक्षण है कि एक राज्य उस विरोध आंदोलन का जवाब कैसे देता है जिसे वह आसानी से वर्गीकृत नहीं कर सकता।**

segments.src: The connectivity blackout that accompanied the crackdown is also the reason nobody can say with confidence how many people have died.**
segments.tr: **दमन के साथ होने वाला कनेक्टिविटी ब्लैकआउट भी वह कारण है जिससे कोई भी विश्वास के साथ यह नहीं कह सकता कि कितने लोग मारे गए हैं।**

segments.src: ## The order of events matters
segments.tr: ## घटनाओं का क्रम मायने रखता है

segments.src: Most accounts of unrest begin with the unrest.
segments.tr: अशांति की अधिकांश रिपोर्टें अशांति से शुरू होती हैं।

segments.src: This one begins with a signal drop.
segments.tr: यह रिपोर्ट एक सिग्नल ड्रॉप से शुरू होती है।

segments.src: On **June 5, 2026**, the government of Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) declared the Jammu Kashmir Joint Awami Action Committee — the JAAC, the loose coalition that had organized the region's protest politics for three years — a proscribed organization under the **AJK Anti-Terrorism Act, 2014**.
segments.tr: **5 जून, 2026** को, आज़ाद जम्मू और कश्मीर (AJK) की सरकार ने जम्मू कश्मीर जॉइंट अवमी एक्शन कमेटी — JAAC, वह ढीला गठबंधन जिसने तीन वर्षों से क्षेत्र के विरोध की राजनीति का आयोजन किया था — को **AJK आतंकवाद विरोधी अधिनियम, 2014** के तहत एक प्रतिबंधित संगठन घोषित कर दिया।

segments.src: Internet access across the territory was curtailed the same day.
segments.tr: उसी दिन पूरे क्षेत्र में इंटरनेट एक्सेस को सीमित कर दिया गया।

segments.src: The monitoring group NetBlocks confirmed a major disruption to connectivity, noting that the shutdown arrived *ahead* of the protests rather than in response to them, and was likely to limit coverage of what followed.
segments.tr: निगरानी समूह NetBlocks ने कनेक्टिविटी में एक बड़े व्यवधान की पुष्टि की, यह देखते हुए कि शटडाउन विरोध प्रदर्शनों की प्रतिक्रिया में नहीं, बल्कि उनसे *पहले* आया था, और संभवतः इसके बाद जो हुआ उसका कवरेज सीमित करने के लिए था।

segments.src: Two days later, on **June 7**, the AJK Supreme Court ruled that the twelve reserved assembly seats at the center of the dispute are constitutionally protected and cannot be abolished without a constitutional amendment — closing, at least judicially, the door the protesters had been pushing on.
segments.tr: दो दिन बाद, **7 जून** को, AJK सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने फैसला सुनाया कि विवाद के केंद्र में मौजूद बारह आरक्षित विधानसभा सीटें संवैधानिक रूप से सुरक्षित हैं और संवैधानिक संशोधन के बिना उन्हें समाप्त नहीं किया जा सकता — जिससे, कम से कम न्यायिक रूप से, वह दरवाजा बंद हो गया जिसे प्रदर्शनकारी धकेल रहे थे।

segments.src: The mobilization that had been building since talks collapsed in late May became a regionwide movement almost immediately.
segments.tr: मई के अंत में बातचीत टूटने के बाद से जो लामबंदी हो रही थी, वह लगभग तुरंत एक क्षेत्रव्यापी आंदोलन बन गई।

segments.src: On **June 8**, initial clashes reportedly killed eleven people.
segments.tr: रिपोर्टों के अनुसार **8 जून** को शुरुआती झड़पों में ग्यारह लोग मारे गए।

segments.src: On **June 9**, the JAAC called a general strike that shuttered markets, schools, and transport, concentrated most heavily in the **Poonch division**.
segments.tr: **9 जून** को, JAAC ने एक आम हड़ताल का आह्वान किया जिससे बाजार, स्कूल और परिवहन बंद हो गए, जिसका सबसे अधिक प्रभाव **पूनच डिवीजन** में देखा गया।

segments.src: By mid-June the reported toll had passed twenty.
segments.tr: जून के मध्य तक रिपोर्ट किया गया मृत्यु आंकड़ा बीस को पार कर गया।

segments.src: The sequence — ban, blackout, court ruling, confrontation — is the story.
segments.tr: यह क्रम — प्रतिबंध, ब्लैकआउट, अदालत का फैसला, टकराव — ही कहानी है।

segments.src: It is also why the story is so hard to verify.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि इस कहानी की पुष्टि करना इतना कठिन है।

segments.src: ## What the twelve seats actually are
segments.tr: ## बारह सीटें वास्तव में क्या हैं

segments.src: The AJK Legislative Assembly reserves twelve of its seats for **Kashmiri refugees who left Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir after the 1947 partition**, along with their descendants.
segments.tr: AJK विधायी विधानसभा अपनी बारह सीटें **उन कश्मीरी शरणार्थियों के लिए आरक्षित रखती है जिन्होंने 1947 के विभाजन के बाद भारतीय प्रशासित जम्मू और कश्मीर को छोड़ दिया था**, और उनके वंशजों के लिए।

segments.src: Those voters live elsewhere in Pakistan — Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa — not in AJK.
segments.tr: वे मतदाता पाकिस्तान में अन्य स्थानों पर रहते हैं — पंजाब, सिंध, खैबर पख्तूनख्वा — AJK में नहीं।

segments.src: To supporters of the arrangement, the seats are a constitutional and symbolic commitment: they keep the displaced population represented in the only Kashmiri assembly available to them, and they encode Pakistan's long-standing position that the Kashmir question is unresolved rather than settled by a border.
segments.tr: इस व्यवस्था के समर्थकों के लिए, ये सीटें एक संवैधानिक और प्रतीकात्मक प्रतिबद्धता हैं: वे विस्थापित आबादी को एकमात्र उपलब्ध कश्मीरी विधानसभा में प्रतिनिधित्व देते हैं, और वे पाकिस्तान के इस लंबे समय से चले आ रहे रुख को संहिताबद्ध करते हैं कि कश्मीर का प्रश्न सीमा द्वारा तय होने के बजाय अनसुलझा है।

segments.src: To the JAAC and its supporters, the seats are a governance problem with a very practical edge.
segments.tr: JAAC और उसके समर्थकों के लिए, ये सीटें एक शासन समस्या हैं जिसका एक बहुत ही व्यावहारिक पहलू है।

segments.src: Twelve seats in a 53-member house is not a rounding error.
segments.tr: 53 सदस्यीय सदन में बारह सीटें कोई मामूली त्रुटि नहीं हैं।

segments.src: Because the electorate for those seats sits outside AJK, the argument goes, national parties headquartered in Islamabad and Lahore can assemble a bloc that does not answer to anyone who actually lives with AJK's electricity tariffs, wheat prices, road conditions, or hospital waiting rooms.
segments.tr: तर्क यह है कि क्योंकि उन सीटों के लिए मतदाता AJK के बाहर रहते हैं, इसलिए इस्लामाबाद और लाहौर में मुख्यालय वाले राष्ट्रीय दल एक ऐसा ब्लॉक बना सकते हैं जो AJK के बिजली टैरिफ, गेहूं की कीमतों, सड़क की स्थिति या अस्पताल के प्रतीक्षा कक्षों के साथ वास्तव में रहने वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति के प्रति जवाबदेह नहीं है।

segments.src: The movement's complaint is not primarily about identity.
segments.tr: आंदोलन की शिकायत मुख्य रूप से पहचान के बारे में नहीं है।

segments.src: It is about who holds the swing vote in a legislature that decides where money goes.
segments.tr: यह इस बारे में है कि उस विधायिका में निर्णायक वोट किसका है जो यह तय करती है कि पैसा कहाँ जाएगा।

segments.src: That distinction is what has made the movement difficult for the state to define.
segments.tr: यही वह अंतर है जिसने राज्य के लिए आंदोलन को परिभाषित करना कठिन बना दिया है।

segments.src: It is not separatist in the conventional sense, it is not aligned with a militant network, and its demands are budgetary and procedural rather than territorial.
segments.tr: यह पारंपरिक अर्थों में अलगाववादी नहीं है, यह किसी उग्रवादी नेटवर्क के साथ जुड़ा हुआ नहीं है, और इसकी मांगें क्षेत्रीय होने के बजाय बजटीय और प्रक्रियात्मक हैं।

segments.src: ## Thirty-eight points, not one
segments.tr: ## एक नहीं, अड़तीस बिंदु

segments.src: The seats have dominated coverage, but they are a single line in a **38-point charter of demands** the JAAC unveiled in September–October 2025 — itself an escalation of protest cycles running back to 2023 over electricity tariffs, flour subsidies, and everyday governance failures.
segments.tr: सीटों ने कवरेज पर हावी किया है, लेकिन वे सितंबर-अक्टूबर 2025 में JAAC द्वारा अनावरण किए गए **38-बिंदु मांगों के चार्टर** की एक एकल पंक्ति हैं — जो स्वयं बिजली टैरिफ, आटे की सब्सिडी और रोजमर्रा की शासन विफलताओं को लेकर 2023 से चल रहे विरोध चक्रों का एक विस्तार था।

segments.src: The charter is unglamorous by design.
segments.tr: यह चार्टर जानबूझकर साधारण रखा गया है।

segments.src: It asks for subsidized power and wheat, investigations into alleged corruption, better schools and hospitals, road and infrastructure spending, and reductions in official privileges and perks.
segments.tr: यह सब्सिडी वाले बिजली और गेहूं, कथित भ्रष्टाचार की जांच, बेहतर स्कूलों और अस्पतालों, सड़क और बुनियादी ढांचे पर खर्च, और आधिकारिक विशेषाधिकारों और भत्तों में कटौती की मांग करता है।

segments.src: It reads less like a manifesto than like a municipal audit.
segments.tr: यह किसी घोषणापत्र के बजाय एक नगर पालिका ऑडिट जैसा लगता है।

segments.src: Officials say most of it has already been delivered.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों का कहना है कि इनमें से अधिकांश पहले ही पूरे किए जा चुके हैं।

segments.src: Leaders in the governing Pakistan Peoples Party bloc have said **35 of the 38 demands** have been implemented, with the remainder blocked by cost, feasibility, or — in the case of the reserved seats — the courts.
segments.tr: शासक पाकिस्तान पीपुल्स पार्टी ब्लॉक के नेताओं ने कहा है कि **38 में से 35 मांगों** को लागू किया गया है, जबकि शेष लागत, व्यवहार्यता, या — आरक्षित सीटों के मामले में — अदालतों द्वारा रोके गए हैं।

segments.src: The JAAC disputes both the count and the quality of implementation.
segments.tr: JAAC कार्यान्वयन की संख्या और गुणवत्ता दोनों पर विवाद करता है।

segments.src: With independent verification constrained by the communications restrictions, that disagreement has no easy referee.
segments.tr: संचार प्रतिबंधों के कारण स्वतंत्र सत्यापन सीमित होने से, इस असहमति का कोई आसान मध्यस्थ नहीं है।

segments.src: ## Why the death toll is a range, not a number
segments.tr: ## मृत्यु संख्या एक सीमा है, कोई निश्चित संख्या नहीं, क्यों

segments.src: This is the part of the story that resists a clean sentence.
segments.tr: यह कहानी का वह हिस्सा है जो एक स्पष्ट वाक्य में नहीं समाता।

segments.src: - **Amnesty International**, on July 28, said at least **40 people** had been killed — 34 protesters and six police and paramilitary personnel.
segments.tr: - **एमनेस्टी इंटरनेशनल** ने 28 जुलाई को कहा कि कम से कम **40 लोग** मारे गए — 34 प्रदर्शनकारी और छह पुलिस और अर्धसैनिक कर्मी।

segments.src: - **Local residents and activists** have put the civilian figure higher, in the range of 50 to 60 or more.
segments.tr: - **स्थानीय निवासियों और कार्यकर्ताओं** ने नागरिक संख्या को अधिक बताया है, जो 50 से 60 या उससे अधिक की सीमा में है।

segments.src: - The **JAAC's own documentation** claims roughly 80 deaths.
segments.tr: - **JAAC के अपने दस्तावेज़** लगभग 80 मौतों का दावा करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Independent journalist Harris Qadeer** reported 89 deaths across Rawalakot and Mirpur by late July.
segments.tr: - **स्वतंत्र पत्रकार हैरिस कदीर** ने जुलाई के अंत तक रवालाकोट और मीरपुर में 89 मौतों की सूचना दी।

segments.src: - The AJK and federal governments have **not published an official toll**.
segments.tr: - AJK और संघीय सरकारों ने **कोई आधिकारिक आंकड़ा प्रकाशित नहीं किया है**।

segments.src: Those numbers are not simply competing estimates from equally equipped counters.
segments.tr: ये संख्याएँ केवल समान रूप से सुसज्जित गणना करने वालों के प्रतिस्पर्धी अनुमान नहीं हैं।

segments.src: They are what happens when mobile networks and internet access in the affected districts are restricted for weeks, roadblocks limit movement, and reporters cannot reach the areas where the worst incidents are alleged to have occurred.
segments.tr: यह वह होता है जब प्रभावित जिलों में मोबाइल नेटवर्क और इंटरनेट एक्सेस हफ्तों तक प्रतिबंधित रहते हैं, सड़क अवरोध आवाजाही को सीमित करते हैं, और रिपोर्टर उन क्षेत्रों तक नहीं पहुँच पाते जहाँ सबसे खराब घटनाओं के होने का दावा किया गया है।

segments.src: NetBlocks documented severe restrictions from early June; connectivity monitors recorded limited service persisting into August.
segments.tr: NetBlocks ने जून की शुरुआत से गंभीर प्रतिबंधों का दस्तावेजीकरण किया; कनेक्टिविटी मॉनिटर्स ने अगस्त तक सीमित सेवा दर्ज की।

segments.src: A blackout does not just suppress information.
segments.tr: ब्लैकआउट केवल जानकारी को दबाता नहीं है।

segments.src: It degrades it.
segments.tr: यह उसे खराब करता है।

segments.src: In the absence of verifiable reporting, both inflated and deflated claims circulate freely, and the resulting fog becomes its own argument — for the state, evidence that the movement traffics in exaggeration; for the movement, evidence that the state is hiding something.
segments.tr: सत्यापन योग्य रिपोर्टिंग की अनुपस्थिति में, बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर और घटाकर बताए गए दावे स्वतंत्र रूप से प्रसारित होते हैं, और परिणामी धुंध अपने आप में एक तर्क बन जाती है — राज्य के लिए, यह प्रमाण है कि आंदोलन अतिशयोक्ति का सहारा लेता है; आंदोलन के लिए, यह प्रमाण है कि राज्य कुछ छिपा रहा है।

segments.src: Neither side can be checked, which is precisely the problem.
segments.tr: किसी भी पक्ष की जाँच नहीं की जा सकती, और यही समस्या है।

segments.src: ## What proscription does
segments.tr: ## प्रतिबंध का प्रभाव

segments.src: Designation under the Anti-Terrorism Act is not a symbolic label.
segments.tr: आतंकवाद विरोधी अधिनियम के तहत पदनाम कोई प्रतीकात्मक लेबल नहीं है।

segments.src: It converts organizing into a prosecutable offense, exposes bank accounts and property to freezing, and criminalizes participation, fundraising, and public advocacy.
segments.tr: यह आयोजन को एक दंडनीय अपराध में बदल देता है, बैंक खातों और संपत्ति को फ्रीज करने के लिए खोल देता है, और भागीदारी, धन जुटाने और सार्वजनिक वकालत को अपराध घोषित करता है।

segments.src: Four JAAC spokespeople — **Shaukat Nawaz Mir, Sardar Umar Nazir, Khawaja Mehran Arshad, and Sardar Aman Khan** — were placed on wanted lists, with bounties reported at roughly $36,000 for information leading to arrests.
segments.tr: JAAC के चार प्रवक्ताओं — **शौकत नवाज मीर, सरदार उमर नज़ीर, ख्वाजा मेहरान अरशद और सरदार अमन खान** — को वांछित सूचियों में रखा गया, और गिरफ्तारी तक ले जाने वाली जानकारी के लिए लगभग $36,000 के इनाम की रिपोर्ट की गई।

segments.src: Mir was arrested on June 30.
segments.tr: मीर को 30 जून को गिरफ्तार किया गया।

segments.src: Other organizers, including Syed Farhad Ali Shah in mid-June, were reported detained.
segments.tr: जून के मध्य में सैयद फरहाद अली शाह सहित अन्य आयोजकों के हिरासत में लिए जाने की खबर मिली।

segments.src: On August 1, journalists **Razi Tahir and Muhammad Saif** were reported taken into custody in Islamabad.
segments.tr: 1 अगस्त को, पत्रकारों **राज़ी ताहिर और मुहम्मद सैफ** को इस्लामाबाद में हिरासत में लिए जाने की खबर मिली।

segments.src: **Amnesty International** called the terrorism designation of a protest movement "a dangerous escalation," and **UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk** joined calls for restraint and investigation into the use of force.
segments.tr: **एमनेस्टी इंटरनेशनल** ने एक विरोध आंदोलन को आतंकवाद का पदनाम देना "एक खतरनाक वृद्धि" कहा, और **संयुक्त राष्ट्र मानवाधिकार उच्चायुक्त वोल्कर तुर्क** ने संयम बरतने और बल के प्रयोग की जांच के आह्वान का समर्थन किया।

segments.src: India's foreign ministry also issued criticism — which Pakistan rejected as interference, with military spokesperson **Lieutenant-General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry** saying authorities had exercised "wisdom and restraint" and that the deployment of force remains solely a state prerogative.
segments.tr: भारत के विदेश मंत्रालय ने भी आलोचना की — जिसे पाकिस्तान ने हस्तक्षेप के रूप में खारिज कर दिया, सैन्य प्रवक्ता **लेफ्टिनेंट-जनरल अहमद शरीफ चौधरी** ने कहा कि अधिकारियों ने "विवेक और संयम" का प्रयोग किया था और बल की तैनाती पूरी तरह से राज्य का विशेषाधिकार है।

segments.src: The government's tone has not been uniform.
segments.tr: सरकार का लहजा एक समान नहीं रहा है।

segments.src: AJK Prime Minister **Faisal Mumtaz Rathore** publicly offered dialogue.
segments.tr: AJK प्रधानमंत्री **फैसल मुमताज राठौर** ने सार्वजनिक रूप से संवाद की पेशकश की।

segments.src: Federal Defence Minister **Khawaja Asif** took a markedly harder line, framing the protesters' obligation as obedience to the state.
segments.tr: संघीय रक्षा मंत्री **ख्वाजा आसिफ** ने काफी सख्त रुख अपनाया, प्रदर्शनकारियों के दायित्व को राज्य के प्रति आज्ञाकारिता के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया।

segments.src: Both positions are official; they point in opposite directions.
segments.tr: दोनों स्थितियाँ आधिकारिक हैं; वे विपरीत दिशाओं में इशारा करती हैं।

segments.src: ## An election held in the dark
segments.tr: ## अंधेरे में आयोजित चुनाव

segments.src: The crackdown collided with a scheduled local election, conducted in three phases:
segments.tr: दमन की कार्रवाई एक निर्धारित स्थानीय चुनाव से टकराई, जिसे तीन चरणों में आयोजित किया गया:

segments.src: | Phase | Date | Area |
segments.tr: | चरण | तिथि | क्षेत्र |

segments.src: | First | July 27 | Mirpur division |
segments.tr: | प्रथम | 27 जुलाई | मीरपुर डिवीजन |

segments.src: | Second | August 2 | Muzaffarabad division |
segments.tr: | द्वितीय | 2 अगस्त | मुजफ्फरबाद डिवीजन |

segments.src: | Third | August 10 (scheduled) | Poonch division |
segments.tr: | तृतीय | 10 अगस्त (निर्धारित) | पूनच डिवीजन |

segments.src: The first phase coincided with a JAAC march and further deadly confrontations.
segments.tr: पहला चरण JAAC मार्च और और अधिक घातक टकरावों के साथ हुआ।

segments.src: Among those killed was **Sardar Usman Nazir**, brother of JAAC leader Sardar Umar Nazir.
segments.tr: मारे गए लोगों में JAAC नेता सरदार उमर नज़ीर के भाई **सरदार उस्मान नज़ीर** शामिल थे।

segments.src: Nazir has denied that the movement is responsible for violence, alleging that incidents were staged — a claim the government rejects and which, like most claims in this dispute, cannot currently be independently assessed.
segments.tr: नज़ीर ने इस बात से इनकार किया है कि आंदोलन हिंसा के लिए जिम्मेदार है, यह आरोप लगाते हुए कि घटनाएं रची गई थीं — एक दावा जिसे सरकार खारिज करती है और जिसे, इस विवाद के अधिकांश दावों की तरह, वर्तमान में स्वतंत्र रूप से नहीं आंका जा सकता।

segments.src: The JAAC called for a boycott.
segments.tr: JAAC ने बहिष्कार का आह्वान किया।

segments.src: Authorities reported turnout above 50 percent and results favoring parties aligned with the federal ruling coalition in the early phases.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों ने शुरुआती चरणों में 50 प्रतिशत से अधिक मतदान और संघीय सत्तारूढ़ गठबंधन के साथ जुड़े दलों के पक्ष में परिणामों की सूचना दी।

segments.src: The third phase is scheduled for **Poonch** — the division where the protests have been most intense and where verification has been hardest.
segments.tr: तीसरा चरण **पूनच** के लिए निर्धारित है — वह डिवीजन जहाँ विरोध प्रदर्शन सबसे तीव्र रहे हैं और जहाँ सत्यापन सबसे कठिन रहा है।

segments.src: Whether a turnout figure means much under those conditions is a genuinely open question, and one that will be argued regardless of the final count.
segments.tr: उन परिस्थितियों में मतदान के आंकड़े का बहुत महत्व है या नहीं, यह वास्तव में एक खुला प्रश्न है, और अंतिम गणना के बावजूद इस पर बहस होगी।

segments.src: ## The actual test
segments.tr: ## वास्तविक परीक्षण

segments.src: Strip away the specifics and what remains is a problem states face more often than they admit: a movement with local, material, largely legalistic demands, no armed wing, and enough popular reach to shut down commerce across a territory.
segments.tr: विशिष्टताओं को हटा दें और जो बचता है वह एक ऐसी समस्या है जिसका सामना राज्य अक्सर स्वीकार करने से अधिक बार करते हैं: एक आंदोलन जिसकी स्थानीय, भौतिक, काफी हद तक कानूनी मांगें हैं, जिसका कोई सशस्त्र विंग नहीं है, और इतनी लोकप्रिय पहुंच है कि वह पूरे क्षेत्र में वाणिज्य को बंद कर सके।

segments.src: Such a movement can be **negotiated with**, which concedes that grievances are legitimate and invites more of them.
segments.tr: ऐसे आंदोलन के साथ **बातचीत की जा सकती है**, जो यह स्वीकार करता है कि शिकायतें वैध हैं और उन्हें और अधिक आमंत्रित करता है।

segments.src: It can be **ignored**, which usually escalates.
segments.tr: इसे **नजरअंदाज किया जा सकता है**, जिससे आमतौर पर स्थिति और बिगड़ जाती है।

segments.src: Or it can be **reclassified** — moved from the category of politics into the category of security, where a far wider set of tools becomes available and the question of whether the demands were reasonable stops being the operative one.
segments.tr: या इसे **पुनर्वर्गीकृत किया जा सकता है** — राजनीति की श्रेणी से हटाकर सुरक्षा की श्रेणी में डाल दिया जाता है, जहाँ उपकरणों का एक बहुत बड़ा सेट उपलब्ध हो जाता है और यह प्रश्न कि क्या मांगें उचित थीं, अब प्रासंगिक नहीं रह जाता।

segments.src: The June 5 proscription was that reclassification.
segments.tr: 5 जून का प्रतिबंध वही पुनर्वर्गीकरण था।

segments.src: It arrived *before* the mass mobilization, not after, and alongside a blackout that made the consequences difficult to document.
segments.tr: यह सामूहिक लामबंदी के *बाद* नहीं, बल्कि *पहले* आया, और एक ब्लैकआउट के साथ, जिसने परिणामों को दस्तावेजीकरण करना कठिन बना दिया।

segments.src: That ordering is what critics point to, and it is the substance of the objection: not that the state acted, but that it defined the problem in a way that removed the need to answer it.
segments.tr: यही वह क्रम है जिसकी ओर आलोचक इशारा करते हैं, और यही आपत्ति का सार है: यह नहीं कि राज्य ने कार्रवाई की, बल्कि यह कि उसने समस्या को इस तरह से परिभाषित किया कि उसे हल करने की आवश्यकता ही समाप्त हो गई।

segments.src: Whether that judgment holds up will depend on evidence that does not yet exist in verifiable form — accurate casualty records, an accounting of detentions, and reporting from Poonch.
segments.tr: क्या वह निर्णय सही ठहरता है, यह उन सबूतों पर निर्भर करेगा जो अभी तक सत्यापन योग्य रूप में मौजूद नहीं हैं — सटीक हताहतों के रिकॉर्ड, हिरासत में लिए गए लोगों का हिसाब, और पूनच से रिपोर्टिंग।

segments.src: Restoring connectivity is the precondition for producing any of it.
segments.tr: कनेक्टिविटी बहाल करना इनमें से किसी को भी उत्पन्न करने की पूर्व शर्त है।

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखें

segments.src: - **The August 10 Poonch phase** — the decisive test of whether the electoral process holds in the movement's stronghold.
segments.tr: - **10 अगस्त पूनच चरण** — यह निर्णायक परीक्षण होगा कि क्या चुनावी प्रक्रिया आंदोलन के गढ़ में बनी रहती है।

segments.src: - **Connectivity restoration** — the single best indicator of whether authorities expect further confrontation, and the gate on all independent verification.
segments.tr: - **कनेक्टिविटी बहाली** — यह इस बात का सबसे अच्छा संकेतक है कि क्या अधिकारी और टकराव की उम्मीद करते हैं, और सभी स्वतंत्र सत्यापनों का द्वार है।

segments.src: - **The status of the proscription** — whether the ATA designation is maintained, narrowed, or challenged in court after the election cycle closes.
segments.tr: - **प्रतिबंध की स्थिति** — क्या चुनाव चक्र समाप्त होने के बाद ATA पदनाम को बनाए रखा जाता है, सीमित किया जाता है, या अदालत में चुनौती दी जाती है।

segments.src: - **An official casualty accounting** — its release, or continued absence, will shape international pressure more than any statement.
segments.tr: - **हताहतों का आधिकारिक हिसाब** — इसकी रिलीज, या निरंतर अनुपस्थिति, किसी भी बयान से अधिक अंतरराष्ट्रीय दबाव को आकार देगी।

segments.src: - **The reserved seats question** — with the judicial route closed, the only remaining path is a constitutional amendment, which returns the issue to the legislature the protesters say is the problem.
segments.tr: - **आरक्षित सीटों का प्रश्न** — न्यायिक मार्ग बंद होने के साथ, एकमात्र शेष रास्ता संवैधानिक संशोधन है, जो इस मुद्दे को वापस उसी विधायिका में ले जाता है जिसे प्रदर्शनकारी समस्या बताते हैं।

segments.tr: ### स्रोतों पर संपादक की टिप्पणी

segments.tr: इस लेख में दिए गए आंकड़े विवादित हैं और उन्हें स्थापित तथ्य के रूप में प्रस्तुत करने के बजाय उनके स्रोतों के लिए जिम्मेदार ठहराया गया है।

segments.tr: प्रभावित जिलों में संचार प्रतिबंधों ने हताहतों की संख्या, हिरासत की संख्या और विशिष्ट घटनाओं के स्वतंत्र सत्यापन को रोका है; आधिकारिक निकायों, मानवाधिकार संगठनों, पत्रकारों और स्वयं आंदोलन के द्वारा रिपोर्ट किए गए कुल आंकड़े काफी भिन्न हैं।
